values.note: Every RV site has electric: $43 a night Sunday-Wednesday nights, Thursday-Saturday +$7. Horsemen's sites $46, not counted. No out-of-state camping rate (the park entrance fee differs by plates). Indiana's rate page gives only statewide ranges; these are the booking site's prices for April 2027 nights, read 2026-10-31.

hookups.source: https://indianastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/potato-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IN&parkId=570039 (per-site Electricity Hookup: 154 sites at 30, 104 at 50 among family-campground Electric), read 2026-10-31

sites.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/parks-lakes/potato-creek-state-park/ ('Electric / 287 sites') + reserveamerica per-site Max Vehicle Length (60 on nearly all, 40 on 3, 63 on 1; 3 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-31

note: 327-acre Worster Lake is the park centerpiece but the campground is set back inland from the shoreline (woods/trails between), not waterfront. --Claude
